## How to test

- [ ] `npm test` passes in the package(s) touched

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is `name/topic`, commits follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Input validation on any new/changed route
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or `.env` files committed
- [ ] Every DB query is scoped to `req.user.id` where it touches user data
- [ ] UI still matches FinSight (screenshot attached if UI changed)
- [ ] `planning/SYLLABUS_MAPPING.md` updated if this covers a syllabus topic
